answers.core: Yes, the reason being that seeing as the engine has the capability to filter by warning messages but yet provide no way to print them, I feel that it is a missing core feature, rather than an add-on feature.
answers.workaround: It could. You could opt instead for using `GD.PrintRich()` and use the `[color=yellow][/color]` BBCode in the text however you would not have the filtering capabilities anymore that the console would have otherwise provided.

title: Add PrintWarn to compliment Print and PrintErr
